page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin. The notes sit beside the lines "lam videri" to "fpondeo". Page number top left. Running head top right. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Objiciunt fecundo, isto pacto honestum civem à sceleratis hominibus spoliari, quod cedit in malum publicum. Respondeo, imo vero honesti civis vitam servari, quod cedit in bonum publicum. Aft latrocinia, inquiunt tertio, & rapinae hac ratione stabilientur, si latronibus non modo impune erit, sed & laute. Respondeo, id si fiat, per accidens fieri: ipsorum vitio, non illius; qui nec juvit ullo modo latrones, nec vel probavit promittendo vel probat promissum fervando ipsorum factum; quin potius dum consuluit sibi, ipsorum quoque sceleri ita impedivit, ut latrones essent solum non item homicidae. Objiciunt quarto Obligationem juramenti oriri ex actu judicii & voluntatis deliberato: ergo ubi voluntas non est libera, ita ut non tam actio dicenda sit quàm coactio, nullam videri sequi {n}Nemo ju-rejurando tenetur, quod per necessitatem adactus est. Sen.1.contr.6.Obligationem. Respondeo, Voluntatem cogi non posse & hoc ab omnibus agnoscitur. Potest quidem esse coactio ex parte principii actionis externi & remoti; sed ex parte principii proximi, quae est in omnibus actibus humanis voluntas, nulla potest esse coactio. Juramentum ergo qui facit latroni, ut vitam servet volens facit

page.notes: The left margin note carries an asterisk at its start. The text mark at "sequi" is a superscript n, so I have linked the note to n and marked it as a doubtful pairing. The word "Poteft qui / dem" is printed with a line break and no visible hyphen, so I have joined it as "quidem". The catchword at the lower right is only partly legible; "ito [?]" is a best reading. The first line is set slightly further left than the body, but the sense ("fecundo") shows it continues the argument from the previous page, so it is marked cont="true". The page ends mid-sentence and continues on the next page. The black edge at the right margin is the neighbouring page and is omitted.
